The '''Yellow Thaelos''' were, along with the [[Stoneskins]], one of the two largest gangs that operated in the [[Warren (location)|Warren]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. They shared their name with the [[thaelo]], a creature found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
